title: Morphisms from closed integer sheaves are determined by generators
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z→X as in [def-weil-closed-immersion], let Z_Z be the constant integer sheaf and use the pro-etale direct image of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For any abelian sheaf N on X, two morphisms i_*Z_Z→N are equal if on every chart U of X they agree on every integer generator obtained from the constant presheaf on Z at Z×_X U by the sheafification unit. There are no finiteness or nonemptiness hypotheses.

source.place: Section 9, p. 67, exact sequence (*), together with the sheafification universal property.

proof.text: Cancel the canonical epimorphism Z_X→i_*Z_Z supplied by the closed integral generation lemma. Equality of the two resulting ambient constant-sheaf maps is sufficient.

Precompose with the sheafification unit. The canonical constant direct-image map is defined by the sheafification adjunction and sends each constant integer to its counterpart on the pulled-back chart. The hypothesis therefore gives equality of presheaf maps, and the adjunction gives equality of sheaf maps. This argument applies unchanged to empty charts.

proof_origin.place: Section 9, p. 67, exact sequence (*), together with the sheafification universal property.

theorem closedIntegral_hom_ext {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    {N : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    {q q' : (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
      ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))) ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (k : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ),
      q.hom.app U ((toSheafify (ProEt.topology Z)
        ((Functor.const Z.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))).app
          ((proEtaleBaseChange i).op.obj U) k) =
      q'.hom.app U ((toSheafify (ProEt.topology Z)
        ((Functor.const Z.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))).app
          ((proEtaleBaseChange i).op.obj U) k)) : q = q'
